footer.description: Clear English-language explanations of Massar Moutamadris, Massar Waliye, grades, results, login, Massar Code and common access problems.

official.title: Looking for the official service?
official.text: Account actions and official results are handled on Ministry of National Education platforms. Only enter credentials at the official address.
